correctness.rationale: Bessel unitary probabilities and sign selection give exact age-conditioned flip kernel. A nonnegative defective renewal kernel with mass 1-2p gives finite exact integrated autocorrelation 1/(2lambda p). Positive Bessel Laplace coefficients prove strict distance monotonicity. The half-integer Legendre integral and Laplace method prove the fixed-rate large-distance prefactor and controlled geometric tail. The Bessel Taylor series and Poisson event conditioning give the short-time order and coefficient. Analytic assumptions and scope are explicit; an independently written standalone checker passed Bessel/Legendre, onset, monotonicity and prefactor tests. Numerical checks do not replace the proof.
